title: Reuse immutable planning reads
responsibility: Cache successful reads pinned to full commit IDs for one planning operation.

inputs.name: planReads.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

outputs.name: planReads
outputs.description: Wrapped Git handle sharing in-flight and successful recognized reads at full lowercase IDs of the repository object format. Returned buffers are copied; mutable revisions, writes, calls with input/environment overrides and failed reads are not retained.
